models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest accounts identified by device fingerprint for anonymous access before registration.

This table represents guest actors who have not yet registered but need temporary identity tracking. Each guest is uniquely identified by their device fingerprint, which persists across sessions until the user either registers as a member or the guest account is cleaned up.

Guest accounts are temporary and intended for anonymous users exploring the application before committing to registration. The device fingerprint serves as the primary identification mechanism, allowing the system to maintain session continuity and track guest activity without requiring email/password credentials.

Related entities:
- {@link todo_app_guest_sessions} - Multiple sessions can exist for each guest account
- {@link todo_app_members} - Guests can upgrade to member accounts through registration

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: Unique device identifier for guest recognition across sessions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest access with expiration tracking.

This table records login sessions for guest actors, storing connection metadata and temporal information for security auditing. Sessions are append-only and track the guest's access period through expiration timestamps.

Related to {@link todo_app_guests} through a 1:N relationship where one guest can have multiple active or expired sessions.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client connection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL href where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from the client request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for security lifecycle management.

models.name: todo_app_members
models.description:
Registered member accounts with email/password credentials and profile information.

This table serves as the primary identity record for authenticated users in the todo application. Each member has a unique email address for authentication and a display name for their profile. Members own private todos and can manage their account settings including password changes and account deletion.

Related entities:
- {@link todo_app_member_sessions} - Login sessions for this member (many-to-one)
- {@link todo_app_member_password_resets} - Password reset tokens (many-to-one)
- {@link todo_app_member_email_verifications} - Email verification tokens (many-to-one)
- {@link todo_app_todos} - Todos owned by this member (many-to-one)

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for authentication and account identification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for secure authentication. Never store plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's display name shown in their profile and todo listings.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was soft deleted. Null if account is active.

models.name: todo_app_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for member authentication with access and refresh token support.

This table tracks login sessions for registered members, storing connection metadata and token information. Each session represents an authenticated connection with expiration tracking for security. Sessions are created on login and expire based on token lifetime or explicit logout.

Related to {@link todo_app_members} through a 1:N relationship where one member can have multiple active sessions across different devices.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token for authenticated API requests.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client device at session creation.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL href where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from the HTTP request headers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid.

models.name: todo_app_member_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens with expiration for secure password recovery workflow. Each token is single-use and expires after a defined period. Tokens are generated when a member requests password reset and are invalidated after use or expiration to prevent replay attacks.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member requesting password reset. {@link todo_app_members.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token sent to member's email address. Used exactly once for password recovery and then invalidated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Token becomes invalid after this time for security purposes and cannot be used for password reset.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was consumed for password reset. Null if token has not been used yet. Prevents token reuse.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp when password reset request was initiated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp. Updated when token is used or any field is modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null if record is active. Used for audit trail and potential recovery.

models.name: todo_app_member_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for account registration and email confirmation.

Stores verification tokens sent to members during registration or email address changes. Each token has an expiration time and tracks when (if) it was successfully verified. Tokens are single-use and expire after a configured period for security.

Related to {@link todo_app_members} through foreign key relationship. Multiple verification attempts can exist per member (e.g., resend verification email), but only the latest unexpired token is typically valid.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token sent via email for account confirmation.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp when the verification token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the email was successfully verified. Null if not yet verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification record was soft deleted. Null if active.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Core todo items owned by members with title, description, optional dates, and completion status.

This table stores the main todo entities that members create and manage throughout their lifecycle. Each todo belongs to exactly one member and supports soft deletion through the deleted_at field for trash functionality.

Key relationships:
- Owned by {@link todo_app_members} through member_id foreign key
- Has many {@link todo_app_todo_edit_histories} for audit trail

Behavioral notes:
- Todos are incomplete by default (completed = false)
- Soft deleted todos (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) appear in trash
- Permanently deleted todos are removed from this table
- All field changes are recorded in edit history table

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title. Required field that identifies the todo task.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the todo task. Can be empty.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Optional start date when the todo task begins. Null if not set.

plainFields.name: due_at
plainFields.description: Optional due date when the todo task should be completed. Null if not set.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Completion status flag. False means incomplete (default), true means complete.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was soft deleted. Null means active todo, non-null means in trash.

models.name: todo_app_todo_edit_histories
models.description:
Audit trail recording all changes made to todos including field values after each edit.

This table captures point-in-time snapshots of todo modifications, enabling users to view the complete history of changes made to their todos. Each edit creates a new history entry with the updated field values.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to {@link todo_app_todos} via todo_app_todo_id (required)
- Multiple history entries per todo (1:N relationship)

Behavioral notes:
- Append-only: New entries are created on each edit, never updated
- Permanently deleted when parent todo is permanently deleted or when user account is deleted
- Sorted by created_at descending (most recent first) when viewing history

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title value after this edit. Null if title was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Description value after this edit. Null if description was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Start date value after this edit. Null if start date was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: due_at
plainFields.description: Due date value after this edit. Null if due date was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Completion status after this edit. Null if completion status was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this edit was made.
